user.title: Connect to your LLM provider
user.description:
Point this at any OpenAI-compatible server, such as vLLM, SGLang, LiteLLM or fastllm proxy. The URL may be the host on its own; /v1 is added if missing.

You add models to this provider in the next step.

data_description.api_key: Leave empty if the endpoint needs no authentication.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach that endpoint. Check the URL and that the server is running.
error.invalid_auth: The endpoint rejected that API key.

abort.already_configured: That endpoint is already set up. Add a model to it instead.

data_description.name: Shown in Home Assistant, for example Voice or Study.
data_description.model: Chosen from what the provider serves. Type a name if it is not listed.
data_description.llm_hass_api: Which tool APIs the model may use. Without one it can talk but not act.
data_description.assistant_name: What the agent calls itself. Match your wake word so it stays consistent.

data_description.prompt: The agent's persona. {name} is replaced with the assistant name above.
data_description.max_tokens: Reasoning models spend much of this before answering, so do not set it low.
data_description.timeout: How long to wait between streamed tokens before giving up.
data_description.supports_tools: Turn off only for models that cannot call tools; the agent then answers without controlling anything.

abort.entry_not_loaded: Set up the provider before adding models to it.
